about: Records of the learn-from-failure loop (ebllm.bllm.selfmod): each attempt, the diagnosis of a failure, the rule it changed and the outcome of the retry. The construction, seed and Hodge runs are this engine's own; the other runs were logged by the attacks that used it on 19 October 2026. In the happy-ending run the engine checked the status of the problem and the searches were the attack's own programs.
